campus_notes: GT Housing publishes room dimensions only as campus-level approximations in its FAQ (https://housing.gatech.edu/first-time-residents/faq): traditional East Campus rooms ~12' x 10' to 15' x 11', traditional West Campus ~15' x 11', Harris suites 12' x 10', Woodruff suites 15' x 12', apartment bedrooms ~11' x 8'10". Windows vary from 44" x 95" to 51" x 116" and all have blinds. Furniture dimensions are published at https://housing.gatech.edu/room-and-furniture: bed frame 38" x 85.5" (Twin XL mattress), wardrobe 36"W x 24"D x 76"H, desk 42"W x 24"D x 30"H, chair 20"W x 23"D x 33"H, dresser 30"W x 24"D x 30"H; all figures approximate. Most beds use the E-Z Loft system (low / medium ~3 ft / high ~6 ft / bunked); only Housing staff may adjust them, and bed rails are required above 36". Furniture may be rearranged but never removed from the room, and homemade lofts are prohibited. Rates shown are official 2026-27 per person per semester (family units per apartment per month). Each building page links per-floor floor-plan PDFs (room numbers and types, no dimensions); URLs are recorded per dorm.

dorms.notes: Zbar Apartments (ZBR) consists of four bedroom two bath apartments. All residents of an apartment share a living room and kitchen, and two residents share one bath. Certain rooms may have a slightly different configuration due to design differences and renovations. Some pictures are of actual student rooms and may contain additional furniture and decoration provided by the resident. Zbar Apartments was built in 1995.

window.notes: Window sizes vary building-to-building from 44" x 95" to 51" x 116" (official FAQ); blinds installed in all windows. Position not published.

closet.notes: No built-in closet; a freestanding wardrobe is provided instead.

built_in_furniture.notes: Twin XL mattress (36" x 80") on a 38" x 85.5" frame. E-Z Loft frame: low (8" clearance), medium (~3 ft), high (~6 ft, desk + dresser fit underneath), or bunked. Adjustments by Housing staff only; bed rails required above 36".
Desk 42"W x 24"D x 30"H.
Dresser/chest 30"W x 24"D x 30"H. Fits under the bed in medium/high positions.
Freestanding wardrobe 36"W x 24"D x 76"H; movable shelves on the right side.
